child.text:
[{"insert":"Hanging Knee Tuck

50 total reps of the hanging knee tuck in as few sets as possible. The hanging position demands grip and shoulder stability while the core is being worked. Break the reps up however you need, but keep the rest short between sets. The goal is to accumulate all 50 with quality.  Flex the hips fully on each rep and lower the legs with control rather than dropping them. If the hanging knee tuck is too much, scale to the tuck up on the floor.
"}]
